pages.text: A **Laser Designator** marks a target for your missiles. Hold use and it goes to your eye: the view zooms in, the reticle shows where the beam lands, and the rangefinder gives the **range** and the **spot's coordinates** (and the creature, if it is on one). A thin red beam runs from it to a pulsing red spot, and everyone sees both: by day they are faint, at night they shine. It reaches **as far as you can see** (your view distance, up to 1,024 blocks), creatures and blocks alike; on a creature the spot follows it. Other players see the whole beam, out to the spot the missiles use.

**On a network.** Use the designator on a [Launch Control Station](ordnance/launch_control_station): it takes the station's network. Its launchers loaded with missiles that have a **Laser Guidance Unit** are the ones it commands, one at a time: the sight shows the one it works with (its number on the network, what it is, and which of them it is, say *2/3*). It starts with the first; **scroll** while zoomed to pick the next (the hotbar stays put), and the designator keeps the pick. The station's map shows your spot while you lase, and its **Laser** button aims the picked launchers at it.

**Arm, then launch.** Lase the target and **left-click**: if the picked launcher is not armed, it is aimed at the spot and **armed**; if it is armed, it **launches**. By the reticle the sight says which: **READY** (a click arms it), **ARMED** (a click launches it), **OUT OF REACH** or **NOT READY**. Once one has launched, the designator moves on to the next.

**Armed targets.** While you are zoomed in, every armed launcher of the network shows where it is aimed, whoever armed it: a glowing sphere at the point you clicked (one aimed from the station sits on top of its target), red for the one you have picked.

**Leading it in.** Keep lasing after a launch: the missile follows **your laser** all the way in, wherever you point it, so you can walk it onto a moving target or onto another one entirely. If you let go, it keeps going where it was headed. The sight counts the missiles **homing** on your spot, and the station's log notes each launcher armed and launched from a designator.

It holds **40,000 FE**: a hundred seconds of lasing; charge it in a [Battery Charger](power/batteries). Smoke or gas between it and the target breaks the beam, and an EMP knocks it out for a while.
